title: Netskope Client Deployment & Traffic Steering at Scale (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (large-scale agent rollout via Intune + steering config + identity; coexistence and live-traffic risk).
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: Roll out the Netskope client to thousands of devices — steered correctly, from day one
problem: A SASE platform only works if its client is actually on every device, healthy, and steering the right traffic. Done by hand, agent rollouts stall: clients fail to enroll, steering configs are inconsistent, and exceptions break business apps. This solution gives you a repeatable way to deploy the Netskope client and traffic steering at scale through Microsoft Intune — packaged deployment, steering and exception configuration, health validation, and ringed rollout to thousands of endpoints.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Netskope client and steering model, Intune-based deployment, steering configuration and exceptions, client health, and the ringed large-scale rollout.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant, Intune, Entra ID, client enrollment method/credentials, steering config, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: package and deploy the client via Intune, configure steering and exceptions, validate client health and steering, ring the rollout, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — client-readiness discovery, client-health and steering validation, a deployment status and exception report, safe remediation of failed/unhealthy clients, and a rollout-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to deploy the Netskope client and traffic steering at scale through Intune — packaged deployment, steering and exception config, health validation, and ringed rollout to thousands of endpoints. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable way to deploy the Netskope client and traffic steering at scale through Intune — packaged deployment, steering/exception config, health validation, and ringed rollout.
